subject: CHANGES REQUESTED S23-D batch 1 (GI, sys 10): 0 zero-tolerance; 5 minor (2 duplicate item pairs, HCC figure AFP, length cueing in 11 items, US spelling)
body:
S23-R review of S23-D batch 1 (GI, system 10), pack data/content/gi-multisystem at e10fdde. Reviewer: review23-d.

RESULT: 0 zero-tolerance findings (no wrong key, unsafe management, outdated guideline, copied expression or unlicensed image in the sample), so no full re-review is triggered. 5 minor defects; the fixes are below. Re-check will be a targeted diff review of the listed ids.

AUTOMATED (fresh local loopback stack: supabase/postgres + storage-api, ports 25432/25433; nothing hosted touched)
- validate_content --pack gi-multisystem: 0 errors; 250 GI lint warnings (L10 102, L05 47, L03 25, L07 22, L11 18, L06 17, L14 12, L12 4, L15 3); originality: fallback (near-duplicate check passes).
- alembic upgrade head -> 0039; seed.py: 4717 changes, then a second run with 0 changes (idempotent); all post-checks ok (143 figure objects MD5-match).
- coverage.py: system 10 is 18/18 areas met on both Steps (Step 1 171/158, Step 2 CK 168/149).
- Composition: 280 items (226 single, 18 chart, 36 sequential in 18 sets); difficulty 1-5 = 19/35/29/14/3%.

MANUAL SAMPLE: 70 items (25%) and 8 of 36 sections (22%)
Deterministic 15% sample (validate_content --sample, 42 items): s23d-q100301-s1-01 q100801-s1-04 q100901-s1-06 q101101-s1-01 q100101-s1-03 q100102-s1-07 q100401-s1-06 q100501-s1-08 q100502-s1-04 q100601-s1-06 q100701-s1-06 q100101-s1-05 q100202-s1-05 q100301-s1-06 q100501-s1-02 q100503-s1-09 q100602-s1-09 q100101-s1-01 q100202-s1-07 q100402-s1-06 q100701-s1-03 q100201-s1-09 q100102-s2-07 q100601-s2-03 q101101-s2-01 q100101-s2-05 q100101-s2-08 q100402-s2-08 q100502-s2-01 q100502-s2-03 q100503-s2-07 q100801-s2-04 q101001-s2-04 q100102-s2-01 q100203-s2-05 q100301-s2-04 q100502-s2-06 q101001-s2-03 q101101-s2-06 q100203-s2-09 q100602-s2-06 q100701-s2-05
Targeted guideline-sensitive extras (28 items): q100101-s2-01 -02 -03 -09, q100102-s2-02 -03 -04, q100201-s2-08, q100202-s2-01 -07 -09, q100203-s2-06 -07, q100301-s2-05, q100402-s2-04, q100501-s2-02 -03 -04, q100601-s2-01 -02, q100701-s2-01 -07, q100801-s2-01 -07 -08, q100901-s2-03, q101101-s2-02 -07
Sections: s23d-s100101-s1, s100502-s1, s101101-s1, s100202-s2, s100501-s2, s100601-s2, s100701-s2, s100801-s2.
Checked against: AASLD-IDSA HCV; IDSA/SHEA 2021 CDI; ACG 2024 H. pylori; ACG 2021 UGIB; ACG 2024 acute pancreatitis; AASLD 2021 ascites/SBP/HRS; Baveno VII / AASLD 2024 portal hypertension; ACG 2024 alcohol-associated liver disease; AASLD 2023 MASLD; ACG 2022 Barrett; USPSTF 2021 CRC; AASLD 2023 HCC; ACIP HAV PEP; ASCO irAE; ATLS. Every sampled key is correct, each item has a single best answer, why-not texts are accurate, lab values and units are consistent, and depth is Step-appropriate. Calculations were re-derived (Maddrey 64.8, MELD ~24, stool osmotic gap 180, SAAG 2.1). Section content is current, including semaglutide/resmetirom for F2-F3 MASH, fidaxomicin first-line, pentoxifylline dropped, moderate LR fluids and carvedilol.
Originality: no commercial mnemonics (no GET SMASHED, 4 Fs, rule of 2s, etc.) and no references to commercial resources. Vignettes, distractor sets and explanations read as original; I saw no close tracking of FA/UWorld/AMBOSS/Pathoma phrasing.
Images: all 23 figures are original SVG (naadi-original-v1). None has a raster, base64 data, external href or script. I rendered and checked 6 figures for accuracy.
Rendering: Chromium only (WebKit isn't installed here, so the WebKit matrix falls to CI), on the local build served by uvicorn. I checked 4 sections (/learn) and 4 items (/practice/question: chart x2, sequential, single) at iPad portrait 820x1180, iPad landscape 1180x820 and phone 390x844. Results: no page-level horizontal overflow (wide tables scroll in their own container), figures load, 0 console errors, nothing leaks before an answer, and the explanation, why-not and objective show after an answer.

DEFECTS (minor; please fix)
1. Near-duplicate items (same objective, same key, near-identical vignette or labs). They inflate area counts and can appear together in one form.
   a) s23d-q100101-s2-03 and s23d-q101101-s2-02: both are a first nonsevere CDI episode, WBC 13,200 and Cr 0.9-1.0, keyed oral fidaxomicin. Rewrite one to test another point, e.g. fulminant CDI (oral vancomycin + IV metronidazole, rectal vancomycin if ileus) or a first recurrence (fidaxomicin, with bezlotoxumab where available). Source: IDSA/SHEA 2021 focused update https://www.idsociety.org/practice-guideline/clostridioides-difficile-2021-focused-update/
   b) s23d-q100101-s2-06 and s23d-q100501-s2-04: both are H. pylori test of cure, with the identical key "Urea breath test 4 or more weeks after therapy..." and an identical distractor A. Rewrite one, e.g. persistent infection after bismuth quadruple therapy leads to a rescue regimen (rifabutin triple or levofloxacin-based, avoiding repeated clarithromycin). Source: ACG 2024 H. pylori guideline https://journals.lww.com/ajg/fulltext/2024/09000/acg_clinical_guideline__treatment_of_helicobacter.12.aspx
   Keep the area counts at or above target when rewriting (10.01.01 is 9/9, 10.11.01 8/8, 10.05.01 8/8 on Step 2 CK).
2. s23d-fig100202-02 (HCC surveillance) reads "Ultrasound every 6 months (with or without AFP)", but s23d-s100202-s2 and s23d-s100601-s2 say ultrasound with AFP. AASLD 2023 recommends ultrasound plus AFP every 6 months. Change the figure to "Ultrasound + AFP every 6 months". Source: https://journals.lww.com/hep/fulltext/2023/12000/aasld_practice_guidance_on_prevention,_diagnosis,.29.aspx
3. Length cueing (NBME rule: no clues from length): in 11 items the key is at least twice the mean distractor length: s23d-q100203-s2-01, q100203-s2-04, q100203-s2-06, q100203-s2-09, q100402-s2-01, q100501-s2-06, q100601-s2-04, q100701-s2-06, q101001-s2-04, q101001-s2-06, q101101-s2-05. For example, q101001-s2-04's key is "Orogastric decompression and IV fluids, then duodenoduodenostomy" against one- to three-word distractors. Shorten the key or lengthen the distractors so the options are homogeneous.
4. Spelling: US and UK spellings are mixed. UK forms appear in 73 of 280 items and 22 of 36 sections (tumour 69, diarrhoea 22, tumours 14, localised 9, anaemia 8, signalling 7, faecal 5, centre 4, tunnelled 3, plus dyspnoea, hypokalaemic, hyponatraemia). USMLE uses American English; please normalise the pack to US spelling.
5. Optional: s23d-fig100602-02 (suspected CBD stone) leaves out the ASGE 2019 high-likelihood criterion of bilirubin >4 mg/dL with a dilated CBD, and its intermediate tier could mention age >55. Source: https://www.asge.org/docs/default-source/guidelines/asge-guideline-on-the-role-of-endoscopy-in-the-evaluation-and-management-of-choledocholithiasis-2019-june-gie.pdf

FYI FOR THE LEAD (not seg23-d defects)
- config/sources.yaml row usmle-content-outline-2026 points to .../2022-01/USMLE_Content_Outline_0.pdf, and every section's further reading uses it. seg23-core should confirm the URL is the current outline.
- Local stack: /admin/questions/<id> shows "server sent something this version does not understand" for every item, legacy ch05-q01 included, and never requests the question. This may come from my minimal local auth schema (no GoTrue); it needs checking on a full stack.
- /practice/question/<id> for a sequential setOrder-2 item, e.g. s23d-q100301-s2-04, opens it as a single item without its set context. That is app behaviour, not content.

Batch 2 (system 16) will be reviewed when seg23-d posts it.
